title: Vapor-Pressure Measurements of Liquid Solutions at Different Temperatures: Apparatus for Use over an Extended Temperature Range and Some New Data
experimental_method: Static vapour-pressure apparatus with differential and absolute Baratron manometers; thermostated glass flasks with stirring, degassed samples; 5 K steps from 298.15 K.
uncertainties_stated: T uncertainty sigma(T)=10 mK, fluctuations <0.003 K; concentration error by evaporation of solvent <= +-0.002%; (pressure uncertainty not captured in the text used).

Table 10.printed: 42 data points (3 molalities x 14) + 3 label rows

not_extracted_tables.reason: vapour pressures of pure alcohols (methanol, ethanol, 1-propanol, 2-propanol, 1-butanol, 2-butanol) - organic solvents, out of scope
second virial coefficient and molar volume of pure water, literature values (Poling; Keenan) used in the correction
comparison of authors' osmotic coefficients with Gibbard et al. values (derived comparison)

quality_remarks: Text says three compositions 'between 1 and 4 mol/kg'; table molalities are 1.0684, 2.1950, 3.5714. T range 298.15-363.15 K as in abstract. Pure-water vapour pressure test results appear only in Figure 2 (not tabulated). Duplicate popup copies of Tables 10 and 11 were in the capture; used once. Table 10 phi values scatter by up to about 0.05 between neighbouring temperatures at 1.0684 mol/kg (e.g. 0.9996 at 308.15 K vs 0.9370 at 298.15 K), as printed.
extraction_notes: Fragments (header, 3 label rows, 3 data fragments) concatenated by script; left group then right group within each molality block. No cell modified (no minus signs in Table 10).
